title: fix(formula): decimal text is judged against the number range before it is scaled
body:
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`toScaledDecimal` 先按数值范围判定十进制文本,再做缩放。超出范围的文本读为无值,低于最小数的文本读为零,零不再按其指数缩放;范围内每一位仍精确保留。
- 为什么改:同一个值以文本和以数字传入时,判定结果必须一致。
- 风险与回滚:范围内的读取不变,数字和 bigint 的读取不变,`divideToPlaces` 与 `formatScaledDecimal` 不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.ts` 的 `toScaledDecimal`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`toScaledDecimal` (`@objectstack/formula`) judges decimal text against the number range before it scales it, the way the same value is judged as a number:

- Text whose number is not finite spells no decimal and reads `undefined`, as a non-finite number already did.
- Text whose number is zero because it is below the smallest number reads as zero, as that number already did.
- A zero is never scaled by its exponent.

Inside the range every digit is still kept exactly. The home-amount projection treats an amount that spells no decimal as before: it leaves the value to the record validator.

## Tests

`packages/formula/src/home-amount-arithmetic.test.ts`: text above the range reads `undefined`; text below the smallest number reads zero, either sign; a zero with an exponent reads plain zero; in-range text keeps every digit (control). The implementer's suite, gate and ablation readings were read by the security#1 seat (brief 6934902629); this PR is opened by the security#2 seat after that seat's clock-out.
